summary.interpretation: The cache-only 100-song replay now adjudicates Wonderwall lyrics against a reviewed, licensed Musixmatch-attributed Google panel whose normalized hash exactly matches the selected text. The official Oasis page sequence is present in order with seven repeat-only additions. This verifies the lyrics text for the catalog-bound 1995 album performance under the reviewed reference policy; exact-master identity and independent upstream lineage remain unclaimed. Key evidence remains 8/8 comparable correct; chords still lack reviewed chart gold.

readerInterpretation.strictVerifiedMeans: A song counts as verified-correct when its selected field matches a reviewed, scope-compatible reference from an accepted source class. For lyrics, a licensed provider panel with an exact normalized hash can qualify when the reviewed recording scope is compatible; independent provider lineage and exact-master identity are reported separately.
readerInterpretation.qualification: Provider-label agreement is useful corroboration, but it is not counted as independent-source verification until upstream lineage is known. Public-page observations count as coverage; text differences need review and recording/edition scope before correctness is assigned.

summary.transpositionInvariantProgressionInterpr: An exact ordered progression hash after transposition normalization corroborates chord quality and bass structure only. It does not establish sounding key, lyric placement, recording identity, independent provenance, or correctness.
summary.officialLyricPageComparisonInterpretatio: Five official artist lyric pages across four Beatles songs and Oasis Wonderwall were compared against selected Genius text; all five normalized hashes differ. Token edit distances are 106, 339, 3, 72 and 7. Three pages have clear matching recording context; Let It Be page text spans the single/album variants, while Oasis corpus edition is unspecified. These pages are practical reference evidence, not automatic correctness gold.
summary.officialLyricSourceCoverageInterpretatio: In addition to selected-text comparison, each official page hash was compared with every cached provider lyric candidate summary for its song. None of the five official hashes exactly matches any candidate in the current offline result set; this is a reference/source coverage gap, not proof that any one transcript is incorrect.
summary.googleLyricsPanelInterpretation: Eight searches produced six displayed panels with hashes (one exact selected-text match and five differences awaiting review) and two searches without a panel. Panel attributions identify Musixmatch or LyricFind; Google is not treated as an independent lineage. No lyric bodies retained.
summary.selectedProviderMeaning: lyrics.selectedProvider is the actual provider of combined base lyrics; lyrics.selectedMetadataProvider records the selected catalog metadata provider.

practicalEvidenceSummary.interpretation: Strict lyric correctness remains separate from useful practical evidence. Of 99 selected lyrics, 15 have exact text support across multiple provider labels and 84 across one label. The Wonderwall row now has a reviewed practical comparison: exact Google/Musixmatch-attributed hash agreement and complete ordered overlap with the official Oasis text, with seven selected-only repeated tokens. It is strong wording corroboration but not exact performance-sequence gold.

googleLyricsPanel.treatment: An exact hash is practical text corroboration, while a different hash is a review lead. Google attributes these panels to Musixmatch or LyricFind; do not count the panel as independent of the attributed upstream provider.

licensedChartKeyComparisons.interpretation: Licensed arrangement-key corroboration only. Matching publisher keys do not establish exact recording-key correctness; differences require edition/capo/transposition review.

practicalEvidenceSummary.doNotInterpretAs: Do not read strict verifiedCorrect as evidence that unverified selected metadata is wrong; practical support counts are not correctness percentages.
